title: • Way Too Many Ads
body: The game itself is actually enjoyable and has good potential. Unfortunately, the excessive amount of ads completely ruins the experience. Ads appear too frequently and disrupt the gameplay to the point where it becomes unbearable. Instead of being entertained, I feel frustrated and annoyed. This level of advertising makes the game feel more like an ad platform than an actual game. Because of this, I am seriously considering uninstalling it, and it is the main reason for giving the lowest possible rating. A great game is being destroyed by greedy ad decisions. Please reconsider this approach, as it drives players away rather than keeping them

title: A little cheat
body: This was my favorite word merge game, it functions smoothly and when you touch on the combined icon it tells you what it represents, however I noticed lately that no matter how I sorted a row it was not catching that I had the right combination, so I give up and use a hint, And the hints would give me the combination that I already know I had right. You’re cheating. For example you can have three words you know go together-let’s say belt, scarf, tie and you try the last word Hat and it’s not correct??, so you cycle through every word and no other word is correct, finally you use a hint and all of a sudden HAT is the word!! What??? I already tried Hat. CHEATING. This game will cheat you.

title: Too many ads
body: The game is fun overall, I really enjoy sorting words. The harder levels with more categories are definitely my fave. At the same time, the ads are a bit too much, they show up after every level (good thing it can be avoided using a vpn). The design feels a little clunky. Some of the word translations seem off if you’re playing on any other language than English. Overall, not a bad game though.

title: Great game, except....
body: Love this game for the most part, with two notable exceptions: 1. Far too many ads, as other reviewers have mentioned. 2. When you find four tiles to complete a category, they instantly compress into one tile with its own title, and there's no way to see which four tiles went into it. A lot of time this happens almost accidentally and I'd love to able to see which tiles I matched. Otherwise, challenging and enjoyable.
